notes: *can* is placed on `אִם` as the fronted question auxiliary of the rhetorical question under rule 17. Competing reading under rule 8: marking the particle `unrepresented` as a question shown by inversion alone and leaving *can* to the verb as its modal.
*any* is an indefinite subject pronoun realizing the verb's own person and number and joins the verb under rule 17; it is not a supplied lexical subject noun.
